links.title: 2. Lexical analysis
links.why: The language reference for raw string literals and for the warning about invalid escape sequences such as '\d'.

links.title: What’s new in Python 3.14
links.why: Lists the 3.14 changes to re: the z escape and the B escape on an empty string.

links.title: Regular-Expressions.info - Regex Tutorial, Examples and Reference - Regexp Patterns
links.why: The tutorial site the chapter's summary recommends.

links.title: regex101: Online Regex Tester, Builder & Debugger
links.why: One of the two testers the chapter recommends; choose the Python flavour to see how a pattern matches a text.

links.title: Pythex: a Python regular expression editor
